description:
Adds a concorde airplane

The mod adds a concorde plane, working like planes in mod: Ju52, Super Cub, or mods like that.
Tips: 
- Use flaps to land or drive at a slow speed.
- The selection box is finicky; it is located between the two engines, slightly towards the front. This will be fixed in the next update.

Speed at flight: 30 blocs/s
